newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta Church bank reports profit growth in 96.
newsitem.headline: Malta Church bank reports profit growth in 96.

text.p: Malta's APS Bank said on Wednesday it made a profit after tax of 199,000 Maltese pounds ($523,680) in the financial year that ended in December, up by 40 percent over its performance the previous year.
Operating profit rose 37 percent to 330,000 pounds, customer deposits climbed by 26.5 percent to 52.3 million pounds and customers' loans and advances reached 24.7 million pounds, up 39 percent.
Bank chairman Alfred P. Farrugia said the bank, which is fully owned by the church in Malta, intended to issue shares in the future, but no date had been fixed yet.
